meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing (so `npx claude-mem@X.Y.Z` resolves) is handed off to the human maintainer, who raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动管理版本号并生成发布流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发布前都要手动改版本号和写更新日志
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps and release workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually update version numbers and changelogs before every release

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在你要求发布新版本时,自动改好各配置文件里的版本号,跑构建检查、提交代码、打 git 标签并推送,创建 GitHub 发布说明,重新生成更新日志,最后发 Discord 通知。NPM 发布这步会停下交给你手动做。
howto.when: 当你要求为插件『发布新版本』、『bump version』、或『打标签发 release』时触发。

say.text: 帮我把版本号升到 2.1.0 并走完整发布流程
say.note: Claude 会改版本号、提交推送并打标签。

say.text: 这次是修 bug,帮我发一个 PATCH 版本
say.note: 它会把最小版本号加一,不碰新功能。

say.text: 发布新版,记得把 NPM 发布这步留给我手动做
say.note: Claude 会停下等你执行 npm publish。

howto.what_en: On request, Claude updates version strings in all manifests, runs build-and-sync, commits, tags, pushes, creates a GitHub release, regenerates CHANGELOG.md, and sends a Discord note. It stops before npm publish and hands that step to the human.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to bump a plugin's version, e.g. saying 'release a new version', 'bump version', or 'tag and publish a release'.

say_en.text: Bump the version to 2.1.0 and run the full release flow.
say_en.note: Claude updates version, commits, pushes, and tags.

say_en.text: This is a bug fix; release a PATCH version.
say_en.note: It increments the patch number only.

say_en.text: Release the new version, but leave npm publish for me.
say_en.note: Claude stops and waits for you to run npm publish.
